acquisition_method: followed by data dependent acquisition with an isolation window of 2.0 m/z and a dynamic exclusion time of 30 s was performed
alkylation_concentration: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer)
alkylation_reagent: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer)
cleavage_agent: proteins were resuspended in 40 µL DB with Trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) for overnight proteolytic digestion at 37°C
collision_energy: fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27%
fragmentation_method: The top 12 ions were fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: coupled to a Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization_type: equipped with a nano‐electrospray ionization source
labeling: Label-free quantification (LFQ) was performed using the MaxLFQ algorithm integrated into the MaxQuant software
mass_analyzer: coupled to a Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ptm: Carbamidomethyl (C), as a fixed modification, and oxidation (M) and acetylation of the protein N-terminus as dynamic modifications were included
reduction_reagent: Lysates were prepared by mixing samples with SDT-lysis buffer (2% SDS, 500 mM Tris-HCL (pH 7.6), 0.5 M DTT)
